item.title: Trump administration faces questions over top aide Natalie Harp’s security clearance
item.summary: Ex-White House ethics tsar calls it ‘shocking’ that executive assistant to US president didn’t have clearance for a year US politics live – latest updates The White House faced fresh questions on Thursday over whether Donald Trump’s closest aide, Natalie Harp, had access to US government secrets without security clearance. Harp, who is executive assistant to the US president, worked at the White House for a year without the routine clearance, the MS Now network reported on Thursday . She refused to file the relevant forms for unknown reasons, according to two unnamed sources cited by MS Now. Continue reading...
